thread:
sana: Heads up 1: Lumina Labs signed off to be a short customer case + webinar mention. Need: one-line exec quote, consent for publishing + clips, recording time, and webinar lead routing. Brief: https://drive.redwood.com/lumina-brief

diego: I can take the interview. Tue or Wed mornings PT work for me (20-30m).

ben: Producer here  I can do Wed 9:30am PT. I'll record, capture transcript, and produce a 60s promo + 15s teaser. Do we need captions?

sana: Yes captions please. Ben please include a prep doc with 3 bullets and a request to approve the 60s clip on the call. Diego can you confirm Wed 9:30?

diego: Confirmed.

rachel-sales: For routing: want webinar registrants to create leads with utm_campaign=lumina-launch and hidden field product_interest=lumina. SF queue: SDR_Lumina. Also add tag "webinar_lumina" on lead creation.

sana: Noted. rachel, can you confirm ownership of the SDR queue rule for company_size > 1000?

rachel-sales: Confirmed. I'll add an AE reroute rule for enterprise accounts.

marina-legal: Quick legal notes: 1) we need explicit consent text including use cases (case page, social, webinar repurposing). 2) Metrics must state measurement window and that they are from aggregated production workload. No forward-looking or comparative vendor claims. Paste the exact final quote here for review.

sana: Draft quote to propose on call: "Lumina Labs reduced inference costs by ~42% and lowered p95 latency from ~820ms to ~260ms on our October production workload." Also consent template: "By approving this quote, Lumina Labs grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote and associated materials (transcript excerpts, short video clips, and summary statistics) for marketing and sales purposes."

ben: Suggest we ask for a 1-line hero quote (shorter) during the call. Also request permission to use their logo on the case page.

diego: I'll ask for the 1-line hero quote and the logo permission on the call. Will paste their reply here.

ops-bot: Reminder: Submit /legal-review with final quote + consent text. SLA 48h.

marina-legal: Once I have the short quote I'll run it through the template. If they supplied only aggregated metrics, no DPA needed. If any raw logs were shared, we need a DPA + security checklist.

sana: Action items:
- Diego: capture 1-line exec quote + logo permission + consent on call (due EOD Wed)
- Ben: calendar + recording + captions + promo edit plan (invite sent)
- Rachel: form fields, SF queue wiring (SDR_Lumina + product_interest + utm) and AE reroute rule
- Marina: legal to review final quote (48h SLA)

ben: I'll also prepare a short social cut template and two headline options (technical and customer-facing) and drop them here after the call.

diego: They said yes to the logo and will DM a 1-sentence quote after the call.

marina-legal: Received their 1-line quote? Post it here and I'll check redlines.

sana: Great work team. Target publish next Friday and schedule webinar ~7 business days after publish assuming legal signoff.

ops-bot: Task created: "Lumina case + legal review" assigned to marina-legal, due in 48h after submission.
